meta.purpose: Pre-loaded historical lessons so the agent starts with experience instead of cold-starting from zero.
data_sources: NSE historical CSV exports (NIFTY 50 + NIFTY BANK daily 2019-2026, user-provided)

regime_history.2020: COVID crash + V-shaped recovery. Extreme volatility.
regime_history.2021: Recovery/bull, moderate volatility. Daily EMA20 crossover: 50% win rate.
regime_history.2022: Choppy/bear correction (rate hikes, FII selling). Daily EMA20 crossover: 50% win rate.
regime_history.2023: Strong sustained bull trend. Daily EMA20 crossover: 66.7% win rate (best regime for simple trend-following).
regime_history.2024: Trend broke down for simple price-only signals. Daily EMA20 crossover: 12.5% win rate (sharp degradation).
regime_history.2025: Still choppy for pure price signals overall, but RSI-confirmed daily EMA setups did comparatively better (57.1% win rate) — small sample, low confidence.
regime_history.2026_ytd: Correction phase, -6% YTD as of Aug. Pure price-momentum signals remain unreliable (22.2% daily win rate).

strategy_tests.name: Daily EMA20 crossover, no filter
strategy_tests.result: Regime-dependent, unreliable in 2024-2026 (12-22% WR) vs decent in 2023 (66.7% WR). Conclusion: price-only trend-following alone is NOT currently trustworthy as a standalone signal.

strategy_tests.name: Daily EMA20 + RSI 55-75/25-45 confirmation
strategy_tests.result: 28.6% overall win rate, small sample (2-7 trades/yr). Filter reduced trade count but did not fix accuracy.

strategy_tests.name: Intraday 5-min EMA20 + RSI 55-75/25-45
strategy_tests.result: Good frequency (1.57 trades/day) but poor accuracy (22.7% WR), net negative. Frequency matches Saim's 1-2/day target but this exact parameter set is not viable alone.

strategy_tests.name: Intraday RSI oversold(<30)/overbought(>70) recovery-through-50
strategy_tests.result: High accuracy (60% WR) but too rare (0.28 trades/day) — fails Saim's frequency requirement.

strategy_tests.name: Intraday RSI 40/60 (tighter band) + EMA20 trend filter + SL15/TGT25
strategy_tests.result: BEST FOUND SO FAR. 1.56 trades/day (matches target), 42.9% WR, net +88 points over 90 days. Profitable via ~1.67:1 reward:risk, not via high win rate. Current default baseline in engine.py.

strategy_tests.name: ORB (5-min opening range, 15-min candle breakout confirmation, CE above/PE below, SL15/TGT25)
strategy_tests.result: POOR. Only 13 signal days out of 36 (too infrequent), 23.1% WR, net -105 points. Likely cause: 5-min opening range too narrow -> frequent fakeout breakouts. Not currently recommended without further filtering (e.g. wider opening range, volume/candle-body confirmation).

key_conclusions: No pure price-action-only signal tested so far is reliably profitable on its own in the current (2024-2026) market regime.
The 40/60 RSI + EMA20 + SL15/TGT25 setup is the best baseline so far and should be the engine's default until better data (FII/DII, OI) proves a better combination.

RSI parameter tuning alone (band width, oversold/overbought thresholds) trades off frequency against accuracy — no single RSI variant solved both at once. This confirms additional non-price confirmation layers (FII/DII bias, OI order-flow) are necessary, not optional.
ORB-style breakout strategies need a wider opening range or added confirmation before they're viable; the narrow 5-min range version should not be reused as-is.

Missing pieces still to integrate: FII/DII daily positioning bias, options OI order-flow proxy, Greeks (Delta/Theta), SMC-based structure. Until these are added, agent's max achievable score is capped at 6/10 (see engine.py score_setup).
